title: Ghost dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='34' ry='38' fill='#3a5a8c' opacity='0.25'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <path d='M28,42 C28,24 72,24 72,42 L72,72 C72,78 68,80 64,76 C61,73 58,78 54,76 C51,74 48,79 44,76 C41,73 38,78 34,76 C30,74 28,78 28,72 Z' fill='#bfe6ff' stroke='#eaf7ff' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- sheet drape shadow -->
  <path d='M28,42 C28,26 72,26 72,42 L72,50 C62,44 38,44 28,50 Z' fill='#d9f1ff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='45' rx='5' ry='6.5' fill='#2a3f66'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='45' rx='5' ry='6.5' fill='#2a3f66'/>
  <circle cx='43.5' cy='43' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59.5' cy='43' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- happy mouth -->
  <path d='M44,56 Q50,63 56,56' fill='none' stroke='#2a3f66' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- little blush -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='54' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff9fc0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='54' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff9fc0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- dancing arm (left, raised) -->
  <path d='M29,50 C20,44 18,34 24,28' fill='none' stroke='#bfe6ff' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='27' r='4' fill='#bfe6ff' stroke='#eaf7ff' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- dancing arm (right, out) -->
  <path d='M71,50 C80,48 84,40 83,34' fill='none' stroke='#bfe6ff' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='83' cy='33' r='4' fill='#bfe6ff' stroke='#eaf7ff' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- music notes -->
  <g fill='#ffd75e'>
    <ellipse cx='16' cy='20' rx='3' ry='2.4' transform='rotate(-20 16 20)'/>
    <rect x='18' y='10' width='1.8' height='10'/>
    <ellipse cx='86' cy='16' rx='3' ry='2.4' transform='rotate(-20 86 16)'/>
    <rect x='88' y='7' width='1.8' height='9'/>
  </g>
</svg>
